prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore (member-only, 404 otherwise) and an Undo action on the delete message (en/ko); 13 backend tests pass and tsc is clean.

+def _renumber_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID, new: Optional[Episode] = None, position: Optional[int] = None) -> None:
+    """Number a project's live episodes 1, 2, 3... without gaps or repeats.
+    `new` (not yet ordered) is slotted in at 1-based `position`, or last."""
+    episodes = list(session.exec(

+        idx = len(episodes) if position is None else max(0, min(position - 1, len(episodes)))
+        episodes.insert(idx, new)
+    for i, e in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if e.episode_order != i:
+            e.episode_order = i

+    try:

+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+

+        # The deleted episode keeps the order it had when it was deleted.
+        position = episode.episode_order
+        episode.deleted_at = None

+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _setup(client):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import Asset, Episode, StoryCut
+    from app.services.storage import storage
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    pid = project["id"]
+    ep1 = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Pilot", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 1, "story_summary": "Sum"}).json()
+    ep2 = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Second", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2}).json()
+    path = storage.upload_image(b"img-bytes", schema="cuts", identifier="seed")
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        asset = Asset(filename="a.png", file_url=path, file_type="image/png")
+        s.add(asset)
+        s.flush()
+        for i, text in enumerate(["one", "two"]):
+            s.add(StoryCut(
+                episode_id=ep1["id"], cut_order=i + 1, script=text, selected_layout="full", aspect_ratio="1:1",
+                dialogues=[{"speaker": "A", "text": text}], appearing_characters=[{"id": "x", "name": "A"}],
+                image_path=path if i == 0 else None, image_asset_id=asset.id if i == 0 else None,
+            ))
+        s.commit()
+    return h, pid, ep1, ep2
+
+
+def test_duplicate_copies_episode_and_cuts(client):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+
+    h, pid, ep1, ep2 = _setup(client)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    copy = r.json()
+    assert copy["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert copy["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert copy["title"] != "Pilot" and "Pilot" in copy["title"]
+    assert copy["story_summary"] == "Sum"
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        cuts = s.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == copy["id"]).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()
+        orig = s.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == ep1["id"]).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()
+        assert [c.script for c in cuts] == ["one", "two"]
+        assert cuts[0].dialogues == [{"speaker": "A", "text": "one"}]
+        assert cuts[0].appearing_characters == [{"id": "x", "name": "A"}]
+        assert cuts[0].selected_layout == "full"
+        assert {c.id for c in cuts}.isdisjoint({c.id for c in orig})
+        assert cuts[0].image_path and cuts[0].image_path != orig[0].image_path
+        assert cuts[0].image_asset_id != orig[0].image_asset_id
+        assert cuts[1].image_path is None
+
+
+def test_duplicate_is_independent_and_free(client):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+
+    h, pid, ep1, _ = _setup(client)
+    before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    copy = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == before
+
+    client.put(f"/api/v1/episodes/{copy['id']}", headers=h, json={"title": "Take 2"})
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).json()["title"] == "Pilot"
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{copy['id']}", headers=h).json()["title"] == "Take 2"
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        assert len(s.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == copy["id"])).all()) == 2
+
+

+
+def test_delete_closes_the_gap(client):

+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{copy['id']}", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 1

+def test_create_keeps_numbering_gapless(client):

+def test_restore_puts_episode_back_in_place_with_cuts(client):
+    h, pid, ep1, ep2 = _setup(client)
+    third = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Third", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3}).json()

+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        assert len(s.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == ep1["id"])).all()) == 2
+
+
+def test_restore_middle_episode_shifts_later_ones(client):
+    h, pid, ep1, ep2 = _setup(client)
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Third", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3})
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Second", 2), ("Third", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_hidden_from_non_members(client):
+    h, pid, ep1, _ = _setup(client)
